svg.title: Carpenter — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as carpenter, wearing a work jacket and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A claw hammer with a flat striking face stands beside an L-shaped framing square. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
